topic: Write about Overcoming a Challenge(写一篇克服困难的经历)
genre: 记叙文 / 励志(describe a difficulty + how you overcame it + what you learnt)
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修第一册 Unit 2 Developing ideas / Presenting ideas:write about an experience of overcoming a challenge,主题 Onwards and Upwards。
prompt_cn: 假设你叫李华,学校英语报正在征集“勇往直前”主题的故事。请用英语写一篇约100词的短文,内容包括:① 你曾遇到的一个困难是什么;② 最难的地方在哪里、你当时的感受;③ 你如何坚持并克服了它;④ 你从中学到了什么。注意:恰当使用本单元 doing / to do 作宾语的结构(如 enjoy doing、decide to do、keep doing、stop doing 等)。
prompt_en: Suppose you are Li Hua. Your school English newspaper is collecting stories on the theme "Onwards and Upwards". Write a short passage (about 100 words) including: 1) a challenge you once faced; 2) what the hardest part was and how you felt; 3) how you kept going and overcame it; 4) what you learnt. Try to use object structures from this unit, such as enjoy doing, decide to do, keep doing and stop doing.
points: 清楚交代困难(The biggest challenge I faced was …)
写出最难处与感受(The hardest part was … and I felt like giving up)
如何坚持克服(But I decided to … and kept …)
收获与感悟(I learnt that success rarely happens overnight)
model_essay: Last year, the biggest challenge I faced was learning to swim before our school sports day. At first I was the slowest in the class, and the hardest part was the fear of deep water. More than once I felt like giving up. However, I decided to keep trying. I asked my coach to help me, and I practised swimming a little every morning before lessons. Slowly, I stopped feeling afraid and began to enjoy moving through the water. On sports day, I did not win, but I managed to finish my first race. This experience taught me that success rarely happens overnight, and that we should never give up.
model_translation: 去年,我面临的最大挑战是在校运动会前学会游泳。起初我是班里最慢的,最难的地方是对深水的恐惧。我不止一次想放弃。然而,我决定坚持下去。我请教练帮我,每天上课前坚持游一会儿。慢慢地,我不再害怕,开始享受在水中前进。运动会那天我没有获胜,但我顺利游完了第一场比赛。这段经历让我懂得:成功很少一蹴而就,我们绝不应放弃。

rubric.criteria: 四要素齐全:困难 / 最难处与感受 / 如何坚持 / 收获
按时间顺序展开、起承转合清楚、句句围绕主题、连贯自然
恰当运用 doing/to do 作宾语结构、词汇句型准确多样、语法基本无误

required_structure: 点题困难 The biggest challenge I faced was …
最难处 The hardest part was … and I felt like giving up.
坚持 However, I decided to … and I kept …
收获 This experience taught me that success rarely happens overnight.
key_expressions: The biggest challenge I faced was learning to swim.
More than once I felt like giving up.
I decided to keep trying and practised a little every day.
Success rarely happens overnight, so we should never give up.

high_sentences: The biggest challenge I faced was learning to swim before our school sports day.
More than once I felt like giving up, but I decided to keep trying.
Slowly, I stopped feeling afraid and began to enjoy moving through the water.
This experience taught me that success rarely happens overnight.

error_pairs.note: decide 后接不定式作宾语 to do。

error_pairs.wrong: I enjoy to swim every morning.
error_pairs.note: enjoy 后接动名词作宾语 doing。

error_pairs.wrong: I stopped to feel afraid and relaxed.
error_pairs.correct: I stopped feeling afraid and relaxed.
error_pairs.note: '不再害怕'用 stop doing;stop to do 意为'停下来去做'。

paragraph_template:
【克服困难记叙结构】
第1句 点题困难:The biggest challenge I faced was …
第2-3句 最难处与感受:The hardest part was … I felt like giving up.
第4-6句 如何坚持克服:However, I decided to … I kept … Slowly, I …
第7句 收获:This experience taught me that success rarely happens overnight.
